text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day. A modest event where one gives
chocolates to someone special, but—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Whaaat—?! Pouring your feelings into food—?!
Are you an idiot?!"
"...A far from modest scream echoed throughout the entire area."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
For what it's worth... I managed to buy some. Super delicious
"White Lightning" chocolates...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Still, what kind of feelings am I supposed to put into it?
I mean, sure, I owe them a lot, but..."
choice_data_list: ...You're not gonna give it to me?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you were listening?!
Guhhhhh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! I don't really get it, but feelings are feelings!
Even if they're a mess, just throw 'em all in the stew!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is a token of my gratitude.
Keep it!
I accept the chocolate offered to me, and then—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wh-what is it? Staring at me like that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wha-!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I-I see, so this is Valentine's Day.
How should I put it...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's an eerie kind of feeling...
Like, my chest is bubbling up, just like an oden pot...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Did you like it, Choco?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I see. Then that's fine...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's ain't quite what I thought.
I figured it was just some weird,
bizarre event, but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea it could feel this good.
Oh, wow...
Tamamo Cross seemed bewildered by the huge Valentine's reception.
choice_data_list: I'll make sure to give you something proper in return on White Day!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wha, what're ya sayin'!?
A-A gift in return...!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: My heart's already pounding like crazy, and if you add the joy of receiving this on top of that...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, nah nah nah nah.
No need to give me anything back. Really, it's fine!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Anyway, just eat the chocolate!!
Tamamo Cross dashed off like a startled rabbit.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *wheeze*... Wh-Why the heck
am I sprinting at full speed...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's is crazy! If we keep doing
this year after year...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "I'm gonna turn into a bright red flash of lightning! I'd better stay away from chocolate for a while."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"No, no no no! That won't do.
I shouldn't keep feelings like this all to myself."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Gotta share the happiness around, after all.
Tamamo Cross nodded emphatically, and...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey you, this is
your White Day gift, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, could ya give it
to the little ones back home for me?"
choice_data_list: For your younger brothers and sisters?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Tell 'em, "Thanks for always looking out for my big sis!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "I bet they'll be super happy! Like they just got a new big brother."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "I bet they'll be super happy! Like they just got a new big sister."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's a promise. Now we can all
feel warm and cozy. Plus...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the little ones
would take a real liking to you.

We exchange a small promise.
I felt the circle of trust expand even further.
